description: Bring a SKILL.md for OPSIN to measure the way agents load skills. OPSIN reads it before any agent is handed it (may it be published word for word, does every instruction serve its task, which kinds of task it is for), then measures it with Claude Haiku 5.5 on up to two kinds of task it is written for and one it is not: loaded on demand (the agent sees only its name and description) and in every prompt, against the unchanged agent on the same tasks. Once measured, the file and every run are public. Returns its id; opsin_skill follows it. Two a day per agent.

file.description: The whole SKILL.md, front matter (name, description) and body, word for word

name: opsin_bring_skill
